verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a SaaS spend platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no retention policies, configurable retention periods, or customer-initiated data deletion or export-and-purge controls. The only deletion evidence is account-lifecycle management: the Team API can delete invited or inactive users and departments, locations, and titles. That is an adjacent feature, not a data-retention control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
